text:
mia: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for function-calling examples. Adds a few edgecase samples for nullable tool outputs and union-array responses. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5126
sam: nice, can you call out which SDK snippets need updates?
mia: yep — Python md + JS snippet in sections 'Tool output shapes' and 'Parsing nullable fields'
devon: @mia can you add a tiny example for the case where tool returns an array or a single object? that's been tripping customers.
mia: good call. adding this minimal example in the PR:```json
{"result": [ {"id": "123", "val": "ok"} ]}
``` and a note that parsers should accept both `{"result":{...}}` and `{"result":[... ]}`
andre: Quick CI note — the docs linter flags the example because of trailing comma in the JS snippet. I pushed a tiny fix to the branch.
kevin: thanks. also the SDK team wants an explicit JS usage showing `response?.result ?? []` pattern for nullable arrays.
mia: adding that inline. will mark as ready for review after tests.
sam: also add a line about the structured-output guardrail: suggest `maxArrayLength` validation and show fallback to toolcall vs. model-only flow.
mia: done. simplified wording, added the suggestion + short rationale.
docs-bot: build started for PR 5126 — docs-lint, spellcheck, examples-smoke
kevin: small nit — the link in the section header points to an internal RFC that moved. can we change to /rfc/structured-output-v2?
mia: fixed link and rebased.
devon: re: parsing, can we include a one-liner for the SDK tests? Example:```js
const res = await client.callTool('finder', input);
const items = Array.isArray(res.result) ? res.result : (res.result ? [res.result] : []);
```
kevin: perfect. also add a quick note on perf: prefer prefix-caching vs re-requesting when tool responses are stable. small ops note.
mia: added. dropping a TL;DR at the top for engineers.
sam: i'm going to review in ~30m. if looks good i'll merge and trigger the docs deploy. :sparkles:
mia: thank you — ping me if anything else. :pray:
docs-bot: PR 5126 merged by sam — docs deploy queued
kevin: tracked in release notes under "Docs: toolcalling examples & nullable outputs"
mia: great — closing the loop. if we see followups from customers i'll open a short KB with reproductions. :memo:
